meta.name: improve-codebase-architecture
meta.description: Scan a codebase for deepening opportunities, present them as a visual HTML report, then grill through whichever one you pick.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫描代码库,找出架构改进点并生成可视化报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让代码库结构更清晰却不知从何下手
copy.tagline_en: Scan your codebase, find architecture improvements, and generate a visual report.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to improve codebase structure but don't know where to start.

howto.what: 这个技能让 Claude 扫描代码项目，找出较浅、值得深化的模块，生成带前后对比图的网页报告，然后陪你逐个深入讨论改进方案。
howto.when: 当用户明确要求扫描代码库、寻找深化机会并生成报告时触发；该技能不会自动调用。

say.text: 扫描这个代码库，找出值得深化重构的模块。
生成架构改进报告，并告诉我最推荐先做哪个。
say.note: 报告含推荐强度和顶部建议。

say.text: 从报告里选一个候选，我们深入聊聊怎么改。
say.note: Claude 会进入逐项探讨环节。

howto.what_en: Claude scans your codebase for deepening opportunities, presents a visual HTML report, then discusses your chosen candidate in depth.
howto.when_en: Triggers only when explicitly requested by the user; it's not auto-invoked. The user asks to scan the codebase, find deepening opportunities, and present a report.

say_en.text: Scan this codebase for modules worth deepening.
say_en.note: Claude will produce a candidate report.

say_en.text: Generate an architecture improvement report and tell me the top pick.
Pick one candidate from the report and let's discuss it deeply.
